title: Billing-Error Credits on the Time Charge of Customer-Pay Rentals (Rental Vehicle Coordination)
content:
**Rule.** Under Rental Vehicle Coordination, a billing-error credit corrects the time charge the rental partner posted on the final invoice of a customer-pay rental tied to a network repair when that posted time charge is above the time charge the rental should carry. The credit names the posted time charge and is booked on the rental as a customer credit with reason billing error.

## Business effect

| Element | Content |
|---|---|
| Rentals concerned | Customer-pay rentals tied to a network repair, once a time charge stands on the final invoice |
| What is corrected | The time charge posted on the final invoice, where it is above the time charge the rental should carry |
| What the credit names | The posted time charge entry |
| Observable effect | A customer credit with reason billing error, dated the day it is booked, appears in the rental's day and money history, and the renter's outstanding share falls by the amount credited |

## Booking tool: `credit_rental_billing_error_4d32ac17`

**Capability.** Books a billing-error credit against one customer charge on a replacement-rental reservation. The credit reduces what the renter owes on the rental by the amount given and names the charge it corrects; once booked it appears in the rental's day and money history as a customer credit with reason `billing_error`, dated today, and the renter's outstanding share falls by that amount.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `credit_rental_billing_error_4d32ac17` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `rental_reservation_id` | Reference number of the rental reservation the charge was posted on, as returned by the rental reservation lookup | Id |
| `source_entry_id` | Reference number of the customer charge entry being corrected, as returned by the rental day and money history lookup | Id |
| `amount_usd` | Amount credited | USD, 2 decimal places, positive; rounded half-up to the cent when booked |

**Return.** A receipt with `status` ("booked" when the credit was recorded), `rental_entry_id` (reference number of the new credit entry), `rental_reservation_id` (the reservation credited), `source_entry_id` (the charge the credit names), `credit_reason` (always "billing_error"), `amount_usd` (the amount credited, USD with 2 decimal places) and `entry_date` (booking date, YYYY-MM-DD).

## Hypothetical illustration of the contract

Called with a reservation reference, the reference of a time charge entry and an amount of 56.084 USD, the tool books 56.08 USD, the value rounded half-up to the cent, and returns a receipt whose `status` reads "booked" and whose `credit_reason` reads "billing_error".
